title: DobarBoiler: potrošnja i tarife
description: Koliko struje troši bojler i koliko od toga u jeftinoj tarifi (00–08 h).

list.name: porez
list.label: Cene
list.description: Cene iz tabele tarifa su bez PDV-a (20 %) i akcize (7.5 %). Sa porezima: × 1.29.
list.query: bez poreza : 1, sa PDV-om i akcizom : 1.29

panels.title: Potrošeno

targets.rawSql:
WITH tar AS (
  SELECT valid_from, coalesce(lead(valid_from) OVER (ORDER BY valid_from), 'infinity'::date) AS valid_to,
         cheap_start, cheap_end, cheap_price::float8 AS cp, expensive_price::float8 AS ep
  FROM tariff),
bk AS (
  SELECT e.bucket_start, e.bucket_end, e.kwh::float8 AS kwh, e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade' AS ls,
         ((e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time >= t.cheap_start
          AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time < t.cheap_end) AS cheap,
         t.cp, t.ep
  FROM energy_2h e
  JOIN tar t ON (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date >= t.valid_from
            AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date < t.valid_to),
bd AS (
  SELECT ls::date AS d, count(*) AS nb, sum(kwh) AS tot, coalesce(sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE cheap), 0) AS ch
  FROM bk GROUP BY 1),
dy0 AS (
  SELECT coalesce(ed.day, bd.d) AS d, coalesce(ed.kwh::float8, bd.tot) AS kwh, ed.day IS NULL AS partial,
         bd.nb, bd.tot, bd.ch
  FROM energy_day ed FULL JOIN bd ON bd.d = ed.day),
dy AS (
  SELECT dy0.d, dy0.kwh,
         CASE WHEN dy0.partial THEN dy0.ch
              WHEN dy0.nb >= 11 THEN CASE WHEN dy0.tot > 0 THEN dy0.ch * dy0.kwh / dy0.tot ELSE 0 END
         END AS cheap,
         t.cp * $porez AS cp, t.ep * $porez AS ep
  FROM dy0 JOIN tar t ON dy0.d >= t.valid_from AND dy0.d < t.valid_to)
SELECT sum(kwh) AS v FROM dy WHERE d BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date AND (($__timeTo()::timestamptz - interval '1 second') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date

panels.description: „Bez podele“ = dani pre 16. 10. 2026, za koje Ariston čuva samo dnevni zbir, bez satnice.

panels.title: U koje doba dana se troši

targets.rawSql:
WITH tar AS (
  SELECT valid_from, coalesce(lead(valid_from) OVER (ORDER BY valid_from), 'infinity'::date) AS valid_to,
         cheap_start, cheap_end, cheap_price::float8 AS cp, expensive_price::float8 AS ep
  FROM tariff),
bk AS (
  SELECT e.bucket_start, e.bucket_end, e.kwh::float8 AS kwh, e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade' AS ls,
         ((e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time >= t.cheap_start
          AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time < t.cheap_end) AS cheap,
         t.cp, t.ep
  FROM energy_2h e
  JOIN tar t ON (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date >= t.valid_from
            AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date < t.valid_to)
SELECT to_char(ls, 'HH24') || '–' || to_char(ls + interval '2 hours', 'HH24') AS "sati",
  sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE cheap) AS "jeftino", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT cheap) AS "skupo"
FROM bk WHERE bucket_start >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket_start < $__timeTo()
GROUP BY extract(hour FROM ls), 1 ORDER BY extract(hour FROM ls)

panels.title: Mapa potrošnje: dan × doba dana

targets.rawSql:
WITH tar AS (
  SELECT valid_from, coalesce(lead(valid_from) OVER (ORDER BY valid_from), 'infinity'::date) AS valid_to,
         cheap_start, cheap_end, cheap_price::float8 AS cp, expensive_price::float8 AS ep
  FROM tariff),
bk AS (
  SELECT e.bucket_start, e.bucket_end, e.kwh::float8 AS kwh, e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade' AS ls,
         ((e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time >= t.cheap_start
          AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time < t.cheap_end) AS cheap,
         t.cp, t.ep
  FROM energy_2h e
  JOIN tar t ON (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date >= t.valid_from
            AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date < t.valid_to)
SELECT date_trunc('day', ls) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade' AS "time", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 22) AS "22–24", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 20) AS "20–22", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 18) AS "18–20", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 16) AS "16–18", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 14) AS "14–16", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 12) AS "12–14", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 10) AS "10–12", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 8) AS "08–10", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 6) AS "06–08 jeftino", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 4) AS "04–06 jeftino", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 2) AS "02–04 jeftino", sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM ls) = 0) AS "00–02 jeftino"
FROM bk WHERE bucket_start >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket_start < $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mesečna potrošnja (cela istorija)

targets.rawSql:
WITH tar AS (
  SELECT valid_from, coalesce(lead(valid_from) OVER (ORDER BY valid_from), 'infinity'::date) AS valid_to,
         cheap_start, cheap_end, cheap_price::float8 AS cp, expensive_price::float8 AS ep
  FROM tariff),
bk AS (
  SELECT e.bucket_start, e.bucket_end, e.kwh::float8 AS kwh, e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade' AS ls,
         ((e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time >= t.cheap_start
          AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::time < t.cheap_end) AS cheap,
         t.cp, t.ep
  FROM energy_2h e
  JOIN tar t ON (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date >= t.valid_from
            AND (e.bucket_start AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade')::date < t.valid_to),
bd AS (
  SELECT ls::date AS d, count(*) AS nb, sum(kwh) AS tot, coalesce(sum(kwh) FILTER (WHERE cheap), 0) AS ch
  FROM bk GROUP BY 1),
dy0 AS (
  SELECT coalesce(ed.day, bd.d) AS d, coalesce(ed.kwh::float8, bd.tot) AS kwh, ed.day IS NULL AS partial,
         bd.nb, bd.tot, bd.ch
  FROM energy_day ed FULL JOIN bd ON bd.d = ed.day),
dy AS (
  SELECT dy0.d, dy0.kwh,
         CASE WHEN dy0.partial THEN dy0.ch
              WHEN dy0.nb >= 11 THEN CASE WHEN dy0.tot > 0 THEN dy0.ch * dy0.kwh / dy0.tot ELSE 0 END
         END AS cheap,
         t.cp * $porez AS cp, t.ep * $porez AS ep
  FROM dy0 JOIN tar t ON dy0.d >= t.valid_from AND dy0.d < t.valid_to),
mo AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d)::date AS m, sum(kwh) AS kwh_days, sum(cheap) AS ch, sum(kwh - cheap) AS ex,
         sum(cheap * cp + (kwh - cheap) * ep) AS din, sum((kwh - cheap) * (ep - cp)) AS kazna,
         count(*) AS nd, count(cheap) AS nsplit
  FROM dy GROUP BY 1),
mm AS (
  SELECT coalesce(em.month, mo.m) AS m, coalesce(em.kwh::float8, mo.kwh_days) AS kwh,
         coalesce(mo.ch, 0) AS ch, coalesce(mo.ex, 0) AS ex, mo.din, mo.kazna, coalesce(mo.nsplit, 0) AS nsplit
  FROM energy_month em FULL JOIN mo ON mo.m = em.month
  WHERE coalesce(em.month, mo.m) >= (SELECT min(month) FROM energy_month WHERE kwh > 0))
SELECT (ARRAY['jan','feb','mar','apr','maj','jun','jul','avg','sep','okt','nov','dec'])[extract(month FROM m)::int] || ' ' || to_char(m, 'YY') AS "mesec",
  ch AS "jeftino", ex AS "skupo",
  greatest(kwh - ch - ex, 0) AS "bez podele"
FROM mm ORDER BY m

panels.description: Ne zavisi od izabranog perioda. Ariston čuva mesečne zbirove od juna 2025; podela na jeftino/skupo postoji od 16. 10. 2026.

panels.title: Grejanje u skupoj tarifi

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Belgrade', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') AS "vreme",
  CASE attribution WHEN 'app' THEN 'aplikacija' WHEN 'external' THEN 'spolja (Ariston app / dugme)'
    WHEN 'firmware' THEN 'bojler, termostat' WHEN 'firmware_eco' THEN 'bojler, eco' ELSE 'nepoznato' END AS "uzrok",
  detail->>'temp' AS "voda °C", detail->>'target' AS "cilj °C",
  CASE WHEN (detail->>'eco')::boolean THEN 'da' ELSE 'ne' END AS "eco"
FROM event
WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND kind = 'expensive_heating_started'
ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 200
